subject: Runway Surge: coverage drill + forecast checklist
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runway Surge: coverage drill + forecast checklist

Team —

We have a tight window before finance closes Q3 assumptions. I want to run a short "coverage drill" over the next 48 hours to ensure our pipe-to-quota math reflects up-to-date stage health and high-confidence commits. Goal: produce a reconciled coverage number and a prioritized list of 3 micro-commits that can be pushed to closed-won in the next 30 days.

Please do the following before EOD Monday (Jul 30):
- Update Stage % probability for all opportunities >$25k in your book in the shared coverage_spreadsheet_q3.xlsx (column: adjusted_prob).
- Mark any opportunities you want finance to model as "hard commit" in the commit_matrix.csv (new tab: hard_commits).
- Flag any risky accounts with open technical/legal blockers in a separate tab and include a quick one-line mitigation.

Attachments: coverage_spreadsheet_q3.xlsx (template), commit_matrix.csv (example).

Why this matters: finance needs a defensible coverage ratio for the next board cadence. If we can present a reconciled pipe-to-quota snapshot and 3 micro-commits, we avoid conservative write-downs.

I will consolidate Monday night and circulate a short playbook for the commit drills. If any ACs need a 15-min sync, reply with times and I'll slot you.

Thanks —
Tessa
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: coverage_spreadsheet_q3.xlsx (xlsx); commit_matrix.csv (csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Jul 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway Surge: coverage drill + forecast checklist

Tessa —

Acknowledged. I've completed a pass for the west region and updated the coverage_spreadsheet_q3.xlsx (tab: west_update). Quick notes:
- 4 deals >$50k moved from Proposal->Commit after recent POC success (adjusted_prob set to 85%).
- Two accounts (BlueRiver Health, ClearSight) have legal redlines pending; I've flagged them in the new blockers tab with proposed next steps.
- Attached commit_matrix.csv with the 3 micro-commits I think are highest-velocity (rows 2-4).

Short ask from my side: Marcus, can you confirm lighting on the network/infra questions for BR Health by Monday AM? Their procurement told me they'll require a short SOC/JTAC note.

I'll be available for 15m sync Monday 10:00–10:15 if you want a quick readout.

Laura
Sr. Account Executive, West
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: commit_matrix.csv (csv)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway Surge: coverage drill + forecast checklist

Appreciate the quick mobilization. Two leadership notes:
1) Please make sure each "hard commit" has an explicit owner, expected close date, and top blocker documented (one line). Finance will treat owner + date as a tie-breaker for including a commit in the runway.
2) Loop in Lauren early on any deals where finance ops will need an invoice/terms exception.

If we can hand finance a reconciled sheet by Tuesday morning, we stand a good chance of protecting the Q3 target.

-Vivek
VP Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Mira Patel <procurement@blueriver.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runway Surge: coverage drill + forecast checklist

Laura / Tessa —

Thanks for the heads-up. We can accelerate our legal review if you can provide a succinct runbook of the technical controls (SOC scope + data residency) and an expected commercial term sheet. I've attached an initial procurement checklist below.

Proposed next steps:
- Please share the SOC summary + short SAML/KMS notes by EOD Monday.
- I'll ask our finance team to review the DocuSign when you send the contract.

We have one constraint: any changes to standard payment terms need to be flagged now — we have our month-end processing on Aug 7.

Best,
Mira Patel
Procurement, BlueRiver Health
procurement@blueriver.com

---
Attachment referenced: blueriver_procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Mira Patel <procurement@blueriver.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway Surge: coverage drill + forecast checklist

Thanks Mira — good clarity. Laura / Marcus: I'll pick up the SOC summary and SAML/KMS note and drop into the shared Drive link (https://redwood.in/drive/Shared/Forecast/Runway-Surge-Q3) by EOD today. Marcus, please confirm the infra note so I can include it.

Plan for Tuesday:
- 09:00 PST: internal quick sync to finalize the reconciled coverage number (invite sent).
- 11:00 PST: deliver consolidated spreadsheet + finance-scenarios.pdf to finance and procurement.
- 14:00 PST: 30-min alignment with BlueRiver if they want to walk through the technical appendix.

I'll update the commit_matrix.csv with the three prioritized micro-commits and owners immediately after the 09:00 sync.

Tessa
Director, Mid-Market Sales
Redwood Inference
